channel.title: Ziang Ren - Blog
channel.description: Tech blog by Ziang Ren — self-hosting, homelab, web development, TypeScript, Docker, DevOps, and AI agents.

item.title: Hardening an Autonomous AI Agent: How I Deployed OpenClaw on a Mac Mini
item.description: Running an autonomous AI agent at home means treating it like untrusted code. Here's how I locked down OpenClaw with firewall rules, egress filtering, container isolation, model fallback chains, and centralized observability — all on a Mac Mini.
item.author: ziangren@example.com (Ziang Ren)

item.title: Self-Hosted Monitoring with Uptime Kuma: Docker Container and HTTP Endpoint Monitoring
item.description: A complete guide to setting up Uptime Kuma for self-hosted monitoring with Docker container health checks, HTTP endpoint monitoring, Traefik integration with IP allowlisting, and email alerts via Resend SMTP.
item.author: ziangren@example.com (Ziang Ren)

item.title: Setting Up OAuth2 Authentication with Keycloak and Traefik: A Troubleshooting Journey
item.description: A comprehensive guide to configuring OAuth2-Proxy, Keycloak, and Traefik for self-hosted application authentication, covering common pitfalls like hairpin NAT, Vault sealing, and Docker API version mismatches.
item.author: ziangren@example.com (Ziang Ren)

item.title: Typography Showcase
item.description: A comprehensive demonstration of all typography styles, components, and formatting options available in our blog posts. This post serves as both a style guide and visual test.
item.author: ziangren@example.com (Ziang Ren)

item.title: TypeScript Generics: A Practical Guide
item.description: Generics are one of TypeScript's most powerful features. This guide covers the core patterns you'll use every day — from simple type parameters to conditional types.
item.author: ziangren@example.com (Ziang Ren)

item.title: Understanding CSS Grid Layout
item.description: A practical guide to CSS Grid — the most powerful layout system in CSS. Learn the core concepts, common patterns, and when to choose Grid over Flexbox.
item.author: ziangren@example.com (Ziang Ren)

item.title: Homelab Journey: Docker Compose for Everything
item.description: Docker Compose is the backbone of my homelab. Here's how I structure my deployments, manage configurations, and keep services running smoothly.
item.author: ziangren@example.com (Ziang Ren)

item.title: Homelab Journey: Installing and Configuring the OS
item.description: With hardware ready, it's time to install the operating system. I walk through my Ubuntu Server setup, initial configuration, and security hardening.
item.author: ziangren@example.com (Ziang Ren)

item.title: Homelab Journey: Choosing the Right Hardware
item.description: The first step in building a homelab is picking the right hardware. Here's how I chose my server components and what I'd do differently.
item.author: ziangren@example.com (Ziang Ren)

item.title: Building My Own Server
item.description: Documenting the process of setting up a single-node self-hosted server with secrets management, identity provider, deploying public-facing applications and monitor using Grafana Alloy and Dashboard
item.author: ziangren@example.com (Ziang Ren)

item.title: Welcome to My New Blog
item.description: Introducing my new blog built with Next.js, MDX, and modern web technologies. Learn about the features, technologies used, and what you can expect from future posts.
item.author: ziangren@example.com (Ziang Ren)

item.title: Building Modern React Applications with TypeScript
item.description: A comprehensive guide to building scalable React applications using TypeScript, covering best practices, patterns, and advanced techniques.
item.author: ziangren@example.com (Ziang Ren)

item.title: My Journey in Computer Science: From Curiosity to Career
item.description: Reflecting on my path through computer science education, internships, and building a career in tech, sharing lessons learned and advice for aspiring developers.
